verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a probe confirming that Sentry has an official CLI documented at docs.sentry.io/cli/. That suggests headless, scriptable operation, but nothing in the pack describes CI use, authentication for automation, or what the CLI can do. missing for 10: documented CI/CD usage (e.g. release or sourcemap upload in pipelines), non-interactive token auth, CLI command coverage details, independent or hands-on corroboration of headless automation.
